parameter-group.name: voice
parameter-group.label: Voice
parameter-group.description: Voice configuration options for this speaker.

parameter-group.name: rustpotter_web
parameter-group.label: Rustpotter Web
parameter-group.description: Options for the client keyword spotter Rustpotter.

parameter.name: sinkVolume
parameter.label: Sink Volume
parameter.description: Default sink volume

parameter.name: sinkStereo
parameter.label: Sink Stereo
parameter.description: Use dual channel audio

parameter.name: sampleRate
parameter.label: Sample Rate
parameter.description: Sample rate used for the audio transmitted between client and server. Setting this to client uses the client audio sample rate, therefore avoid client resampling.

parameter.name: clientResampleMode
parameter.label: ClientResampleMode
parameter.description: Audio resampling method applied when the transmission is not on the client sample rate

parameter.name: screenSaverTime
parameter.label: Screen Saver Time
parameter.description: Seconds to activate screen saver (0 for disabled)

parameter.name: dimScreen
parameter.label: Dim Device Screen
parameter.description: Lower the screen brightness while the screen saver is enabled.

parameter.name: keepAwake
parameter.label: Keep device awake
parameter.description: Prevent device from going to sleep/block while running the application.

parameter.name: enableSpotify
parameter.label: Spotify Speaker
parameter.description: Enable spotify integration on this speaker.

parameter.name: tts
parameter.label: Text-to-Speech
parameter.description: The text-to-speech service to use, leave empty to use the default.

parameter.name: stt
parameter.label: Speech-to-Text
parameter.description: The speech-to-text service to use, leave empty to use the default.

parameter.name: voice
parameter.label: Voice
parameter.description: The voice to use if no voice is specified, leave empty to use the default.

parameter.name: hlis
parameter.label: Human Language Interpreters
parameter.description: The human language interpreters to use, leave empty to use the default.

parameter.name: ks
parameter.label: Keyword Spotter
parameter.description: Enables keyword spotting using the specified service.

parameter.name: keyword
parameter.label: Magic Word
parameter.description: The magic word to spot before initiating a dialog, leave empty to use the default.

parameter.name: listeningItem
parameter.label: Listening Switch
parameter.description: If provided, the item will be switched on during the period when the dialog processor has spotted the keyword and is listening for commands.

parameter.name: location
parameter.label: Speaker Location
parameter.description: Link this speaker to a location item.

parameter.name: rustpotterAvgThreshold
parameter.label: Averaged threshold
parameter.description: Spot average threshold (0 for disabled)

parameter.name: rustpotterThreshold
parameter.label: Threshold
parameter.description: Spot detection threshold

parameter.name: rustpotterScoreMode
parameter.label: Score Mode
parameter.description: Indicates how to calculate the final score.

parameter.name: rustpotterMinScores
parameter.label: Min Scores
parameter.description: Minimum number of positive scores to consider a partial detection as a detection.

parameter.name: rustpotterComparatorRef
parameter.label: Comparator Ref
parameter.description: Configures the reference for the comparator used to match the samples.

parameter.name: rustpotterComparatorBandSize
parameter.label: Comparator Band Size
parameter.description: Configures the band-size for the comparator used to match the samples.

parameter.name: rustpotterGainNormalizer
parameter.label: Gain Normalizer
parameter.description: Enables an audio filter that intent to approximate the volume of the stream to a reference level (RMS of the samples is used as volume measure).

parameter.name: rustpotterMinGain
parameter.label: Min Gain
parameter.description: Min gain applied by the gain normalizer filter.

parameter.name: rustpotterMaxGain
parameter.label: Max Gain
parameter.description: Max gain applied by the gain normalizer filter.

parameter.name: rustpotterGainRef
parameter.label: Gain Ref
parameter.description: Set the RMS reference used by the gain-normalizer to calculate the gain applied. If unset an estimation of the wakeword level is used.

parameter.name: rustpotterBandPass
parameter.label: Band Pass
parameter.description: Enables an audio filter that attenuates frequencies outside the low cutoff and high cutoff range.

parameter.name: rustpotterLowCutoff
parameter.label: Low Cutoff
parameter.description: Low cutoff for the band-pass filter.

parameter.name: rustpotterHighCutoff
parameter.label: High Cutoff
parameter.description: High cutoff for the band-pass filter.

channel-type.label: Spot
channel-type.description: Starts dialog processing on the speaker

channel-type.label: Drop In
channel-type.description: Starts an immediate call with other speaker (by id)

channel-type.label: Media Current Second
channel-type.description: Current second for the media currently playing, allow seek

channel-type.label: Media Total Seconds
channel-type.description: Total seconds for the media currently playing

channel-type.label: Media Progress
channel-type.description: Played percentage for the media currently playing, allow seek

channel-type.label: YouTube Id
channel-type.description: Start playing a YouTube video (by id)

channel-type.label: Spotify Id
channel-type.description: Start playing a Spotify song (by id)

channel-type.label: Play Music by URL
channel-type.description: Start playing a song by url using the browser player

channel-type.label: Play Video by URL
channel-type.description: Start playing a video by url using the browser player
